## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a conventional commit (`feat(web): …`, `fix: …`), in the words of the person using Conch
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has tests (and abuse cases, if it touches security)
- [ ] UI changes have stories, checked in light and dark
- [ ] The guides in `apps/docs/content` still say what's true
